result.summary: The intersection features marked crosswalks and traffic signals, but is complicated by the presence of trolley tracks and uneven cobblestone paving. Pedestrian infrastructure is present but appears aged, with faded markings and a lack of visible dedicated pedestrian signal heads.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks embedded in the roadway create a tripping hazard and can be slippery for pedestrians and cyclists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and left foreground running through the intersection

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: The transition between asphalt, cobblestones, and metal tracks creates an uneven walking surface within the crosswalk area.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the intersection and crosswalk zones

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade faded markings to high-visibility 'continental' style thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information and improve safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers at the corners.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps within a residential area. While basic infrastructure is present, the uneven cobblestone pavement in the foreground may pose accessibility challenges for some users.

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: The cobblestone surface in the foreground creates an uneven walking surface that may be difficult for those with mobility aids or strollers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Accessible Path of Travel
interventions.description: Ensure a smooth, level path is maintained through the cobblestone area to improve accessibility for all users.

result.summary: The image depicts a signalized intersection featuring a mix of paved travel lanes with embedded trolley tracks and cobblestone gutters. While sidewalks and a marked zebra crosswalk are present, the pedestrian environment is complicated by utility pole obstructions on the walkway and the presence of rail tracks in the roadway.

hazards.name: Embedded Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Steel rails embedded in the roadway can catch bicycle tires and create a slipping or tripping hazard for pedestrians crossing the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Running longitudinally down the center of the main roadway.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A utility pole is positioned in the middle of the sidewalk, narrowing the effective clear width for pedestrians and those using mobility devices.
hazards.location_in_image: On the right-hand sidewalk near the intersection corner.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light, increasing visibility and reducing conflicts with turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Tactile Warning Strips
interventions.description: Install truncated domes at curb ramps to provide a detectable warning for pedestrians with visual impairments.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection featuring a marked crosswalk, pedestrian signals, and well-maintained sidewalks. The presence of trolley tracks embedded in the roadway introduces a potential tripping hazard and uneven surface for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks embedded in the roadway create an uneven surface and can be slippery, posing a trip hazard for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Running horizontally across the foreground and middle ground of the street.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The white paint of the crosswalk is significantly worn, reducing its visibility to motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, spanning the width of the road.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk using high-visibility continental or ladder patterns to improve driver awareness and compliance.

interventions.title: Pavement Leveling
interventions.description: Repair and level the pavement surrounding the trolley tracks to ensure a smooth, trip-free crossing surface.
